q: Our buyer now wants carbon data every quarter. How do we keep up?
title: Buyer wants carbon data every quarter
short: Build the quarter from the same records you already keep: electricity bills, fuel invoices and production. Close each month as it ends, so the quarter is three months added up, not a scramble. Send the same fields in the same format every time, and flag any estimate.
audience: Suppliers to brands and OEMs moving to quarterly reporting

ol: Collect the month's power and fuel bills.
Work out emissions and intensity per unit.

p: Quarter on quarter intensity. Explain swings from production mix or one-off events before they ask.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
